coverage_summary:
Independent S03 security review: supported_findings = []; operational_findings = []; checks_not_run = true. No concrete vulnerability meeting confidence ≥8/10, or supported S03 operational/resource/test defect, survived source tracing. This is a scoped static review, not a blanket security assurance or real-adapter acceptance.

Evidence basis:
• Admission/revocation: src/daemon.rs:441–460 resolves the supplied control and prepares an immutable action; src/control.rs:1194–1213 rechecks current authority under the target mutex before broker commit. src/acp.rs:741–989 checks captured generation, exact target tuple, duplicate IDs, lifecycle, foreground/interaction and capacity before publishing canonical work and output. The writer at src/acp.rs:1379–1450 transmits retained work without substituting or rechecking a later owner's authority.
• Ownership/provenance: src/control.rs:668–817 implements authority-only release/yield/force, ordinary cancellation revocation without a new grant, and exact reserved-offer acceptance. View reports at :1088–1164 require the original live connection and increasing serial; admission activity at :1207–1208 and native provenance at :2033–2041 distinguish borrowed control from original attachment activity. Conditional acceptance at :1762–1802 revalidates ownership, consent, activity/view observations and eligibility.
• Native input/drafts: src/tui.rs:1025–1070 consumes active ACP events without raw PTY fallback; :1099–1112 excludes doubled-prefix forwarding. src/tui/control.rs:363–375 dispatches the captured envelope unchanged and :709–713 rejects native forwarding to ACP. src/tui/agent.rs:195–253 invalidates mismatched bindings; :534–820 separates navigation/paste/editing from deliberate actions and restores only synchronously unqueued prompts under their original exact binding. Interaction admission uses the exact pending responder/revision and offered permission ID at src/acp.rs:850–909, :1792–1909.
• Untrusted adapter/public metadata: src/acp.rs:1452–1578 bounds frame accumulation and queued/in-flight ingress and preserves FIFO processing. :1580–1789 validates session/RPC association and retains actual stop/error outcomes rather than inferring cancellation. :992–1054 gates conversation projection on explicit include_content; :1145–1176 projects disposition metadata, not questions/answers/raw errors. Canonical text sanitization at :2365–2382 and :2501–2538, plus host rendering sanitization at src/tui/agent.rs:2204–2257, prevent adapter escape/control data becoming terminal instructions.
• Owned processes and unsafe code: src/acp.rs:1210–1332 uses direct executable/argv spawn, setsid, captured ProcessTree ownership and outside-authority cleanup/reaping/worker joins. src/runtime.rs:597–615 and :716–829 implement birth-qualified process checks and termination. tests/acp/native.rs:91–233, :286–380 were inspected for openpty/FD ownership, controlling-terminal setup, pinned Zsh leader, bounded raw capture, termios restoration and drainer cleanup. Its fixed shell source passes values as quoted positional arguments; no attacker-controlled shell-source interpolation was identified. Resource/process-sensitive test code and unsafe Rust were not categorically excluded.
• Scenario evidence: inspected the current admission unit, seven backend and four native S03 cases, peer barriers/interrupt/rendering modes, README/changelog claims, and supplied runtime records. artifact://1346 directly records one admission unit and eleven S03 integration passes; its tail records successful strict Rust stages and OMP 8 tests/49 assertions. Workspace totals and outside-test CLI/PTY outcomes are parent-supplied evidence, not checks I executed. The current source includes the removed forwarding assertions, successful-original-leader cleanup guard and rendered Foreground:none readiness barrier described in the freeze brief.

No builds, tests, lint, formatters, payload execution, provider/auth/network operations, repository writes or other reviewer-report reads were performed. Historical e03/S01 caps and S04/live-provider gates remain unchanged. Frozen hashes could not be independently recomputed with the mounted tools; that limitation is recorded separately.
